data.summary:
**When:** [Your Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase).

**Target:** Up to 2 **TYRANIDS** units of yours in your army's [Synapse Range](vsdata:ability/tyranids.synapse), or a single other **TYRANIDS** unit of yours.

**Effect:** Pick a Hyper-adaptation. It is active for those units, alongside any other active for your army, until [your next Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase).

**Restrictions:** You cannot pick the Hyper-adaptation you picked as the [first battle round](vsdata:core-rule/start-of-battle-round) began.
